Task 1


```{r}
setwd("~/Downloads")
getwd()

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

orderItems = read.csv("order_items.csv")
products = read.csv("products.csv")

meanPrice = mean(orderItems$price, na.rm = TRUE)
medianPrice = median(orderItems$price, na.rm = TRUE)

meanPrice
medianPrice


ggplot(data = orderItems) +
  geom_histogram(mapping = aes(x = price), binwidth = 100, na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Item Prices",
    x = "Item Price",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) 

priceFrequency = orderItems %>%
  count(price, name = "Frequency") %>%
  arrange(desc(Frequency))

mostFrequentPrice = head(priceFrequency)
mostFrequentPrice



itemProduct = orderItems %>% inner_join(products, by = "product_id")

# Calculate Pearson correlation
correlationResult = cor.test(
  itemProduct$product_weight_g,
  itemProduct$freight_value,
  method = "pearson"
)

correlationResult

ggplot(data = itemProduct) +
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = product_weight_g, y = freight_value)) +
  geom_smooth(
    mapping = aes(x = product_weight_g, y = freight_value),
    method = "lm") +
  labs(title = "Freight Value vs Product Weight",x = "Product Weight (g)",y = "Freight Value")
```
